html:
GitHub repo candidate recon — 2026-09-12

Filter recap: merged PR since 2026-06-01; title/body references a real issue in-repo (#N, Fixes/Closes #N, or full URL); PR diff has 20-1500 additions in non-test source files, plus >=1 changed test file; combined thread (PR issue-comments + PR review comments + linked issue's comments) >= 4; >=2 changed source files preferred.

Excluded from "source" accounting: tests/, test_*, *_test.py, docs/, *.md, *.rst, resources/, fixtures/.

py-pdf/pypdf

Search: is:pr is:merged merged:>=2026-06-01 -> 188 merged PRs since cutoff. Of these, 68 have at least one #N/issue-URL reference in title+body (rest are plain merges, dependency bumps referencing dozens of old issues in changelog text, or PRs with no issue reference at all). Checked the top 11 by comment volume in detail (files + review_comments + linked-issue comments).

pypdf clears the bar (6/11 checked candidates pass) — stopping here, no fallback repos needed.

Passing candidates

3905 3318 ENH: AppearanceStream: Consider more encodings for Type1 core fonts 169 6 3 47 (4 + 40 + 3) 2026-08-12
3853 3398 ROB: Improve RC4 fallback when cryptography can't provide it 61 1 1 23 (5 + 7 + 11) 2026-08-20
3929 3924 BUG: Decode low-bit DeviceRGB images as RGB instead of palette 33 1 1 10 (6 + 1 + 3) 2026-08-04
3969 3963 DEV: Detect minor version bumps in make_release.py 32 1 1 5 (4 + 1 + 0) 2026-08-19

Notes:

  • 3738's "source files" includes a 1-line sample-files submodule-pointer bump and a 1-line pyproject.toml change alongside the real pypdf/_page.py edit; even excluding those, _page.py alone (134 additions) is within range.
  • 3853, 3929, 3969 have only 1 non-test source file each (fails the ">=2 files" preference, not required per spec — recorded, not excluded).

Reject histogram (11 candidates checked in detail)

  • Linked reference is actually a PR, not a real issue: 1 (PR 4023 -> "issue" 4018 is a PR)
  • Non-test source additions < 20 (too small a diff): 4 (PR 3841: 1 line; PR 4062: 2 lines; PR 3954: 12 lines; PR 3819: 8 lines)
  • Passed all checks: 6

(57 remaining referenced-issue candidates and 120 no-reference PRs were not checked in detail; budget was stopped once pypdf cleared the >=2-candidate bar with margin.)

Fallback repos

Not checked — pypdf yielded 6 passing candidates (>= 2), so per instructions the fallback list (fgmacedo/python-statemachine, celery/kombu, graphql-python/gql, narwhals-dev/narwhals, Textualize/textual, pytest-dev/pytest) was not consulted.
